rules.statement: A confession recorded by a Magistrate without complying with the requirements of sections 134 and 302 of the Criminal Procedure Code is inadmissible in evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a Police Magistrate records the confession of an accused person, without complying with any of the requirements of sections 134 and 302 of the Criminal Procedure Code,- Held , the confession was inadmissible in evidence."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Criminal Procedure Code, ss. 134, 302-404 or null
